convert_superpoint_checkpoint: convert a SuperPoint PyTorch checkpoint from a URL to HuggingFace Transformers format
get_superpoint_config: get a SuperPointConfig with encoder, decoder, and keypoint detection hyperparameters
create_rename_keys: create a mapping of original checkpoint keys to HuggingFace SuperPoint model keys
prepare_imgs: load sample COCO images from URLs for testing the converted model
test_convert_superpoint_checkpoint: test the SuperPoint checkpoint conversion with expected output shape and value assertions
